note: flags from an independent visual reviewer who looked at the compare images

flags.problem: Light/yellow halo runs along the black outlines against the magenta background. At 1:1 the face is posterised into flat tonal bands and loses the painted texture of the original, so it reads as plastic.
flags.fix: Reduce the edge-sharpen or label_blend weight (w below 0.5) so outlines don't ring, and keep the original tonal bands. Re-run the gate with the halo check. Usage is null, so this is low priority.

flags.problem: At 1:1 the diagonal borders and dashed rivets are soft, with transitions about 4px wide. The original flat-graphic edges were crisp, so the dashes smear into the diagonals.
flags.fix: Use a flat-graphic route for this unit: quantise to the original palette and upscale with a hard-edge or sharp-edge method (lower label_blend w, or skip the blur step), so the dash pattern stays distinct at 1:1.
